raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "14.2.8"

recipe:
  name: reproc-split
  version: ${{ version }}.post0

source:
  url: https://github.com/DaanDeMeyer/reproc/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 27c3b452bfc419a2deda23969aa10c77909c4ff9e71c549eb65d09ae6aa7aa32
  patches:
    - if: osx
      then: apple_gettime.patch
    # When the open file descriptor limit > 1048576, reproc
    # (and therefore micromamba) aborts when starting a new process
    # As upstream is inactive, pick up the patch in the feedstock instead
    # https://github.com/DaanDeMeyer/reproc/pull/103
    - 103-remove-fd-limit.patch
    # When version 14.2.7 was released, the cmake project version was not so it still
    # appears as version 14.2.4. This patch sets the cmake project version to the correct version.
    # As upstream is inactive, pick up the patch in the feedstock instead
    # https://github.com/DaanDeMeyer/reproc/pull/121
    - 121-fix-cmake-version.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: reproc-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "build.sh" if unix else "build.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja

  - package:
      name: reproc
    inherit: reproc-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "install.sh" if unix else "install.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc", upper_bound="x.x") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: win
            then:
              - "@echo on"
              # Positive file tests
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc\run.h (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc.lib (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc.dll (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc\reproc-config.cmake (exit 1)
              # Negative file tests
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc++\run.hpp (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc++.dll (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc++\reproc++-config.cmake (exit 1)
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-c/ -B build-test-c/ %CMAKE_ARGS%
            else:
              # Positive file tests
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc/run.h
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc/reproc-config.cmake
              # Negative file tests
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc++/run.hpp
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc.a
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++.a
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc++/reproc++-config.cmake
          # Run a test that links to the library
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-c/ -B build-test-c/ ${CMAKE_ARGS}
          - cmake --build build-test-c/
          - cmake --build build-test-c/ --target test
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-c/
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - cmake
            - ninja

  - package:
      name: reproc-cpp
    inherit: reproc-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "install.sh" if unix else "install.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc-cpp", upper_bound="x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: win
            then:
              - "@echo on"
              # Positive file tests
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc++\run.hpp (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++.lib (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc++.dll (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc++\reproc++-config.cmake (exit 1)
              # Negative file tests
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++_static.lib (exit 1)
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-cpp/ -B build-test-cpp/ %CMAKE_ARGS%
            else:
              # Positive file tests
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc++/run.hpp
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc++/reproc++-config.cmake
              # Negative file tests
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc.a
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++.a
          # Run a test that links to the library
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-cpp/ -B build-test-cpp/ ${CMAKE_ARGS}
          - cmake --build build-test-cpp/
          - cmake --build build-test-cpp/ --target test
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-cpp/
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
            - cmake
            - ninja

  - package:
      name: reproc-static
    inherit: reproc-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "install.sh" if unix else "install.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
      run_constraints:
        - reproc <0
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: win
            then:
              - "@echo on"
              # Positive file tests
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc\run.h (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc\reproc-config.cmake (exit 1)
              # Negative file tests
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc++\reproc.hpp (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc.dll (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc++.dll (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc++\reproc++-config.cmake (exit 1)
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-c/ -B build-test-c/ %CMAKE_ARGS%
            else:
              # Positive file tests
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc/run.h
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc.a
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc/reproc-config.cmake
              # Negative file tests
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc++/reproc.hpp
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++.a
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc++/reproc++-config.cmake
          # Run a test that links to the library
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-c/ -B build-test-c/ ${CMAKE_ARGS}
          - cmake --build build-test-c/
          - cmake --build build-test-c/ --target test
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-c/
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - cmake
            - ninja

  - package:
      name: reproc-cpp-static
    inherit: reproc-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "install.sh" if unix else "install.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc-static", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("reproc-static", exact=True) }}
      run_constraints:
        - reproc-cpp <0
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: win
            then:
              - "@echo on"
              # Positive file tests
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\reproc++\reproc.hpp (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++_static.lib (exit 1)
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\reproc++\reproc++-config.cmake (exit 1)
              # Negative file tests
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc.dll (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\reproc++.lib (exit 1)
              - if exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\reproc++.dll (exit 1)
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-cpp/ -B build-test-cpp/ %CMAKE_ARGS%
            else:
              # Positive file tests
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/reproc++/reproc.hpp
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++.a
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/reproc++/reproc++-config.cmake
              # Negative file tests
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libreproc++${SHLIB_EXT}
          # Run a test that links to the library
              - cmake -G Ninja -S test-cpp/ -B build-test-cpp/ ${CMAKE_ARGS}
          - cmake --build build-test-cpp/
          - cmake --build build-test-cpp/ --target test
        files:
          recipe:
            - test-cpp/
        requirements:
          build:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
